description: COPILOT_HOME replaces ~/.copilot, so process logs are written to $COPILOT_HOME/logs/process-<timestamp>-<pid>.log.
note: Telltale registers only project-local logs/copilot and does not read COPILOT_HOME. The file reuses a Telltale fixture; whether 1.0.96 still writes these lines at the default level is unconfirmed.
